description: Find evidence before choosing a media workflow, diagnosing a failed result or comparing creative/technical approaches. Search model/version plus the constraint; inspect matching records with get_record before applying them. Public reads need no account. Searches cover: discussions (questions, answers, findings), projects, sources, workflows, prompts, experiments, evaluations, assets and articles. Filters: types, categories (no license/level filter; such arguments are refused). Hits: id, type, title, status, evidence (inspection/execution/review), snippet, url.
name: search
title: Search media knowledge
